title: Ask the Heat
reference: while not wall_ahead { while heat_ahead { wait } forward }
hints: Counting beats works, but you can also just ask: is there heat ahead?
While there is heat ahead, wait. Then step.

story.intro: PATCH: "The Mirage Lab. Nothing in here is where it looks. Bots in this lab don't count beats, they ask. Try the heat ahead sensor."
